Teaching Support Specialists are professionals with subject matter expertise who can add value to the teaching/learning experience and help to engage students in the online classroom. Qualifications may be derived from work/industry experience as well as from prior graduate level coursework in the specified academic area. Duties include, but are not limited to, development of group/team assignments, grading, moderating discussion forums, facilitating virtual class sessions, and providing student feedback on assignments/activities. Teaching Support Specialists will assist students with technical/course content issues upon request.

As a Consulting Manager for Moss Adam's Enterprise Systems Consulting, I am responsible for system selections, technology assessments, strategic technology planning, security consulting, process re-engineering, and implementations.  Moss Adams Advisory Services serves clients throughout the firm by providing expertise in information technology, business consulting, litigation support, and business valuation.  In this role, I aid in many different platforms, but have the heaviest focus on growing the NetSuite practice.

As a Managing Consultant/NetSuite Manager, your role will be responsible for managing the delivery of NetSuite’s Professional Services implementations of the on-demand NetSuite application for Hein and Associates’ NetSuite clients as well as serving as a NetSuite subject matter expert in the sales process. Working with the rest of the Technology & Management Consulting Practice (TMC), you will assess client needs, develop plans to solve their problems and implement these plans to help our clients achieve their business goals utilizing NetSuite. You must have a passion for helping clients find creative ways to more effectively run their businesses utilizing the technology as a driver. Finding ways to improve the satisfaction and loyalty of our clients is a top priority.  In addition, you will work as part of the team to bring in new business and help hit the revenue targets for the team.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Delivery of NetSuite including configuration, process re-engineering, support escalation, and Q&A
Plan, manage and communicate the progress of the project, achieving project milestones and maintaining momentum of projects
Document business processes, business mapping, business requirements and meeting notes
Mentor junior team members including knowledge transfers, coaching, and Q&A
Maintain control of multiple projects and assignments while sticking to tight deadlines
Ensure team billable utilization targets are met
Serve as the NetSuite subject matter expert in presales scenarios and deliver demonstrations as well as help scope and estimate projects

As a Sr. Solution Principal, I am responsible for working jointly with the NetSuite Direct Sales and Account Management Groups in the General Business Vertical to provide scoping, solutioning and estimation of the Professional Services effort required for new Sales Opportunities.  I am also responsible for presenting and delivery of the final Statement of Work (SOW) for the Professional Services to implement the products sold and to work with the Sales team during the initial discovery and demo process to ensure that the prospect’s requirements are fully understood and included in the implementation SOW.

Essential Responsibilities:

- Work with Sales reps and Solution Consultants to validate in and out of scope requirements and assist with solutioning as necessary.
- Work with Practice Vertical Leads, Practice Directors and Practice Managers to determine best approach to Professional Service offerings based on prospect and scope.
- Prioritize and Manage Professional Services opportunities
- Create Statements of Work and develop cost estimates for Professional Services efforts.
- Maintain internal sales force automation system to manage and prioritize Professional Services sales opportunities.
- Develop, deliver and sell high-impact Professional Services Value Proposition.
- Participate in pricing and Statement of Work presentations to prospective customers to present and discuss contents of an SOW

- May require to assist in the planning phase of projects

- Assisting clients with mapping their budget & priorities to the scope and deployment strategy

I am responsible for working directly with customers to document and validate their business requirements and map them to NetSuite functionality. I directed all operations activities in a distribution center environment within the Tier II classification of distribution centers, approximately $40M - $70M in revenue. I was responsible for operational excellence and process improvement; ensuring customer expectations are exceeded; and talent acquisition, development, and retention of associates. I operated as a strategic partner with logistics and supply chain management in establishing and adhering to operating budgets.

Major Tasks, Responsibilities and Key Accountabilities
- Ensure efficient distribution operations and adherence to policy, procedure and process excellence. Ensure environmental health and safety excellence through compliance with all safety and Hazmat rules and regulations, legal regulations, and human resource policies.
- Responsible for talent management including selection, termination, performance review and professional development of direct reports.
- Ensure appropriate staffing levels to meet service, financial and operational support demands.
- Manage carrier services and dedicated delivery processes. Partner with support staff to ensure compliance with all DOT regulations.
- Effectively utilize training programs to develop sales and operations expertise within the facility.
- Act as liaison to functional leadership to ensure customer satisfaction and problem resolution. Coordinate and communicate effectively with all company departments.
- Develop annual operating budgets in support of the corporate financial goals and responsible for P&L management. Complete cost justification and determine ROI.
- Achieves cost control through productivity of personnel, efficient utilization of facility space and proper protection of stored materials. Ensure accurate inventory levels and prevent shrinkage.

>  Hire, Coach and Train 42 direct reports on all daily distribution center tasks.
>  P&L responsibilities of approx. $ 38 million.  60,000 sq. ft. facility.
>  Successfully launched two large-scale ERP improvements.  Managed Project scope, cost, and timeline.
>  Communicate and Train all impacted departments within Order-to-Cash Sales Cycle.
>  Created and Presented investment and budget proposals to board of directors and senior management for upcoming projects and requirements for future fiscal periods.  Presentations included ROI, ROA, and KPIs.
